title: Work IQ: human in the loop for agents and agent flows
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, control paths and consumption-billing statement are supported. It correctly distinguishes existing controls from the planned human-in-the-loop capability, leaves undocumented details open and reports Microsoft's conflicting write-operation defaults.

claims.quote: Work IQ uses consumption billing. A separate spending policy isn't required for Work IQ.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Any additional charge specific to human-in-the-loop pauses or approvals is not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: "Work IQ" approvals human in loop billing credits price identity audit. Opened Work IQ in Copilot Studio and Overview of usage-based billing; these establish general Copilot Credits consumption but no separate charge for this planned pause or approval feature.

claims.claim: Tenant administrators can reach Work IQ MCP policy through Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > Tools > Work IQ MCP > Policy.
claims.quote: In the left navigation, select Agents > Tools. ... In the tools registry, select Work IQ MCP. ... On the Work IQ MCP details pane, select the Policy tab when it's available.

claims.claim: An API or automation equivalent for the Work IQ MCP tenant policy switch is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Work IQ MCP" policy Microsoft Graph API tenant settings; "Work IQ" "policy" "graph.microsoft.com/beta". Opened Policy governance for Work IQ MCP; read MCP overview and tool-reference excerpts. No policy-management method, versioned endpoint or command was documented.

claims.claim: The Work IQ MCP policy article says mutation operations, including sending email, are not allowed by default.
claims.quote: By default, mutation operations aren't allowed for safety. This restriction includes create, update, delete, and action requests that modify data, such as sending email.

claims.claim: The Work IQ in Copilot Studio page says write operations are on by default, conflicting with the MCP policy article.
claims.quote: Write operations are on by default. Your organization's permissions and policies still apply.

claims.claim: The maker confirmation setting is at Copilot Studio > Agents > agent > Tools > tool > Details > Ask the end user before running.
claims.quote: In Copilot Studio, select Agents, and then select your agent. ... go to your agent's Tools page and select the tool. The configuration page has three sections: Details, Inputs, and Completion. ... Ask the end user before running

claims.where: controls[1].governs and note; What's changing; Governance controls
claims.claim: Makers can configure a per-tool setting that asks the end user to confirm before that tool runs.
claims.quote: Ask the end user before running | Asks the user to confirm before the tool runs. Set to No by default.

claims.claim: The cited Copilot Studio tool-configuration article describes agents using the standard harness.
claims.quote: This article describes features used in agents or agent flows powered by the standard harness.
